DemoTip: Demo Mode is for play only
RulesTipWarn:
This game is intended for users aged 18 and above for 
 entertainment only. Virtual currency has no real-world value.
BACCARAT_RulesTipInfo:
・Drop in your coins —the curtain rises right away.
・Player and Banker each grab two cards; a surprise third
    may swoop in if Baccarat rules call for an encore.
・Only the last digit counts, and the bigger single-digit steals 
    the show.
BINGO_RulesTipInfo:
・Bingo uses 1 card and a ball draw system. Each 5×5 card
    has 24 unique random numbers.
・The center square is free and 
    automatically marked.
・Form a complete line of 5 numbers—horizontal, vertical, or 
    diagonal—to win.
・Each card can earn up to 7 winning lines.
CLASSICDICE_RulesTipInfo: Only roll outcomes that hit the green area are winners.
COINFLIP_RulesTipInfo:
It’s fast, simple, and all about luck — just guess if the coin will 
land on heads or tails.
DOUBLE_RulesTipInfo:
Spin the wheel and land on one of 15 tiles — hit the green 
diamond for the biggest prize!
HASHDICE_RulesTipInfo:
・Set a predicted interval first, such as 49999 < random 
    number;
・Then set the amount of this round, and click ROLL; The 
    result will be a random number between 0 and 99999;
・If 49999 < random number, then you win; or you lose. 
・Tip: Players may set high and low interval. 
    High: 1999-99998 <random number
    Low: random number <1-98000
・Winning profit is at least 1.0102x and the maximum could 
    go up to 99,000 x.
MINE_RulesTipInfo:
・Select the number of mines you wish to place for the round.
・Press BET button to start the round.
・Each gem revealed will increase the payout multiplier. 
・Cash out any point to win at the last multiplier displayed.
・If a mine is revealed, the game is ended and your wager is 
    lost.
・You may set more mines to increase multipliers on each 
    gem revealed.
ROULETTE_RulesTipInfo:
・Place your chips on any number or group you think the ball 
    will land on.
・Press “Bet” to start the roulette wheel and watch the ball 
    drop into a random slot.
・If the result matches your bet, you win coins based on the 
    payout rate!
STELLARRUSH_RulesTipInfo:
・Start by placing a bet.
・Multipliers begin at low values (e.g., 1.09x) and increase 
    with each planetary milestone, such as 1.25x, 1.43x, and 
    beyond. 
    The further you progress, the higher the risk and reward.
・Four levels of difficulty-Easy, Medium, Hard, and Daredevil-
    allow players to tailor the gameplay to their preferred level
    of challenge.
・In the reviewed setup, Medium difficulty offers a balanced
    experience with moderate risk and rewards.
TOWERLEGEND_RulesTipInfo:
・Choose a difficulty and bet to begin.
・Pick one tile per row — yellow is safe, red ends the game.
・Cash out after any safe pick to win: Reward = Bet × 
    Multiplier.
WHEEL_RulesTipInfo:
Use some coins to start the wheel spinning. Pay close attention 
until the end of the game.
